specificationName: Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment

changesApplied.changeMade: Added --ns '{{ .Values.database.namespace }}' and --db '{{ .Values.database.name }}' args to SurrealDB server startup
changesApplied.reason: SurrealDB server must use the same namespace/database that init-schema Job connects to. Without these args, server uses default namespace/database causing BackoffLimitExceeded errors in init-schema Job.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - additive change only. Blast radius: init-schema Job (will now succeed), RPC API (already configured for metabob/production). No downstream changes required.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added --ns '{{ .Values.database.namespace }}' and --db '{{ .Values.database.name }}' args to SurrealDB server startup
changesApplied.reason: StatefulSet used when persistence enabled (production mode). Same namespace/database configuration needed for consistency with Deployment mode and init-schema Job expectations.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - additive change mirroring Deployment. Ensures persistent and in-memory modes use identical configuration. No downstream impact.

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed initSchema.enabled from false to true, updated comment to reflect fix
changesApplied.reason: Re-enable automatic schema initialization now that namespace/database mismatch is resolved. Ensures 13 tables and 8 indexes are created automatically on fresh deployments without manual intervention.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk - enables previously disabled Job. Job will run on helmfile apply as post-install hook. Success depends on namespace/database args (fixed in changes 1-2). Expected outcome: Job completes successfully, creating all required tables.

enforcementImpulseId: enforcement-Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment

rippleEffectsSummary.upstreamChanges: None - values.yaml already defined database.namespace and database.name
rippleEffectsSummary.downstreamChanges: init-schema Job will succeed, RPC API unchanged, Dashboard unchanged
rippleEffectsSummary.crossCuttingConcerns: All SurrealDB clients use same namespace/database from values.yaml

validationSteps: helmfile -e default destroy && helmfile -e default apply
kubectl get jobs -n metabob | grep init-schema
